notes.content:
Hello StartBolita players! I want to express my gratitude for playing this puzzle game and making our community an exciting experience.

In 2023, one of our main goals is to improve StartBolita and provide you with the best gaming experience possible. That's why we have prepared exciting updates and events for you to enjoy.

[list]
[*] In April, we introduced Laser-Laser, a new puzzle where you must guide a laser to a specific point.

[*] In May, you can participate in Hard-No-Puzzle, an event where you must get from point A to point B without solving puzzles, but with exciting achievements to unlock.

[*] In June and July, we will add 45 new puzzles to the list to keep the fun and challenge going.

[*] In October, we will celebrate the Halloween event, and in December, the Christmas event.
[/list]

Remember to share the experience that StartBolita provides with your friends and help us reach our goal of selling 5k copies to continue creating exciting content for you.

Thank you for playing StartBolita and being part of our puzzle community!

notes.title: StartBolita Chirstmas Box
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9173428/c17bddc82b2b72fa9f0bb76444d998b13759074a.png[/img]

Hello to all players! We are excited to announce that our game has just received a big update. Want to know all the new features we've included? Here we tell you!

In this update, we have used Unreal Engine 5.1 in the Windows version, and we will soon be launching the versions for Mac and Linux.

[list]
[*] 20 new levels and 10 new levels each month
[*] Improved performance and bug fixes
[*] Enhanced gamepad support and a new language
[*] A level selection menu and new achievements
[*] Coming soon, versions for Mac and Linux
[/list]

Don't miss the opportunity to try out all these new features. Update your game on Steam now and keep enjoying. We'll see you there!
